name: Inheritance
source:
Dive into magical, but dangerous world with "Inheritance" today!
And find out the truth behind your cousin’s mysterious death with an eye-catchingly handsome new friend

[From official site]
translation:
现在就跟随《Inheritance》，走进这个充满魔法与危险的世界！
与一位俊美得让人移不开目光的新朋友一起，查明你那位堂表亲离奇死亡背后的真相。

[摘自官方网站]
